newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Steady to lower on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Steady to lower on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady to lower levels Thursday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
Four barges traded versus none Wednesday.
- Four barges, Mid-Mississippi River, two each week of May 4 and May 11, traded at 125 percent of tariff.
- Two barges, Illinois River, this week, bid 110 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Illinois, next week, no bid, offer 120 percent, no comparison.
- 18 barges, Mid-Mississippi, two each week of June and July, bid 115 percent, down 2-1/2 percentage points from Wednesday, similar, offer 125 percent, unchanged.
- 18 barges, Illinois, two each week of June and July, bid 105 percent, unchanged from Wednesday, similar, offer 115 percent, unchanged.
